# Contributing

Contributions are welcome as issues and pull requests on
[GitHub](https://github.com/lqgentner/s1bursts). This page covers setting up a
development environment and building this documentation.
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/lqgentner/s1bursts/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
holds the full development guidelines and the reasoning behind the design.

## Set up and test

The project uses [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). These commands install the
environment and run the checks that every pull request must pass:

```{.bash}
uv sync
uv run pytest
uv run ruff format
uv run ruff check --fix
uv run pyrefly check
```

The default tests run offline. Tests that download data or run SNAP are marked
`integration` and run with `uv run pytest -m integration` if CDSE
credentials and a SNAP installation are available.

## Build the documentation

The site is built with [Great Docs](https://posit-dev.github.io/great-docs/),
which also needs [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/). Guide pages
live in `user_guide/`, the API reference comes from the docstrings, and
`great-docs.yml` configures the site:

```{.bash}
uv sync --group docs
uv run python -m ipykernel install --sys-prefix --name python3
uv run great-docs build
uv run great-docs preview
```

The build writes the site to `great-docs/_site/`, which is generated and never
edited by hand.

## Frozen tutorials

The tutorials download real data and run SNAP, which takes too long for every
build. Their results are therefore frozen: `_freeze/` stores each page's
rendered output and figures, and builds reuse it without running the code. CI
builds the site from `_freeze/` alone, without credentials or SNAP.

Refresh a frozen page after changing its code, its text or the API it uses.
The frozen output includes the text, so the site shows an edit only after the
page is refreshed. This reruns
the page, so it needs `.env` and SNAP. Downloads and products are cached in
`cache/docs/` and reused. Refresh one page per command, then rebuild:

```{.bash}
uv run great-docs freeze user_guide/10-glacier-backscatter.qmd
uv run great-docs build
```

Review the new figures and the `_freeze/` diff before committing. Each frozen
page ends with its run details: the date, the s1bursts version and the SNAP
version it was run with.
